problem: Before implementation, regression tests reproduced ignored same-frame primary press/release rail clicks in Classic size/opacity and zoom controls. The keyboard comparison already passed.
changes: Shared Classic slider input extends drag sense with coalesced taps, preserves native changed flags and consumes handled axis arrows. Ordinary press/drag smart aim and accessibility requests remain with egui. Integer tool values map to nearest range values; zoom uses its existing logarithmic mapping and centipercent precision. Changed taps request relayout/repaint so the native shell and accent decoration settle together. Brightness reuses the common path.

gui.scope: Full suite passes after the input fix and expanded midpoint/endpoint checks. A new opt-in exporter was then added and separately executed; final all-target Clippy includes it (25 current opt-in tests). New 1x/2x tests cover coalesced tool/opacity clicks, logarithmic zoom midpoint and both endpoints, single/repeated-layout keyboard equivalence and no document/history/canvas-paint publication. Existing brightness accessibility, endpoint, slider geometry, typed drafts and view checks pass.

regression_evidence: before.log.gz contains the two reproduced failures and passing keyboard comparison before production changes; targeted.log.gz shows the initial fixed cases, and the final full run includes the expanded zoom coverage.

gpu.scope: Six light/dark captures reached through real same-frame press/release taps: size 33 / opacity 50%, zoom midpoint 111.8%, zoom minimum 12.5%.

clippy: Strict workspace all-targets passed on final source.
checks: Formatting, whitespace and source file length checks passed.
limits: This corrects Classic slider input and keeps native drag/AT paths; it does not qualify physical devices, OS screen readers, Windows parity or a rendering-performance improvement. Roadmap milestones remain partial.
